name: spine-supported-platforms
body: Spine completion [autonomous]. requirements.requirement.supported-platforms drove only domain.value.target-platform; `realised-by` applies only from a domain group|entity|service, so the spine dead-ended. Added `drives` -> domain.service.publish-release (the release workflow builds exactly one binary per target for which a GitHub-hosted native runner exists). domain.service.publish-release is already realised-by solution.component.release-workflow (implemented-by .github/workflows/release.yml) and solution.component.native-e2e-ci. Path: supported-platforms -> publish-release -> release-workflow -> .github/workflows/release.yml. No new implemented-by anchor was needed; existing `drives` to domain.value.target-platform kept.
